_comment: Work-type -> engine routing (FRANK v2 spec Part 4). The Governor reads this at dispatch. A work-type NOT listed here is a HARD STOP (fail-closed), never a default-to-Opus. Deterministic work has llm:false and must never spawn a model. This file is a durable artifact so Codex, Claude, and future sessions stay coherent.

deterministic-extraction._note: CSV->rows, unit normalization, censoring flags. tools/autonomy/extract-source-values.mjs. No LLM: schema-bound, verifiable.

routing-fanout._note: build-routing-audit.mjs + Part 18 lint. CLAUDE.md Part 5b forbids a model maintaining routing.

standards-arithmetic._note: basis-conversion.mjs + percentile math. Part 19 is a locked formula.

auto-fetched-ingest._note: PRIMARY producer. Free on the Plus sub; authored 100% of real output 2026-06-09. Opus never authors a routine source page.

manual-fetch-ingest._note: Messier PDFs/OCR/products judgment. Judgment-bounded, checkable by the auditor. Does not need Opus.

audit-adjudication._note: 5-check audit. Cross-check by a DIFFERENT engine (codex), not a second Opus.

discovery-scoring._note: HMI-fit ranking against fixed criteria. Embarrassingly cheap.

synthesis._note: Part 9 pooling. Analytical, but inputs are already-extracted rows; high effort only on the contradiction/2-A-tier triggers.

defensibility-audit._note: Litigation-facing, contestable, asymmetric-authority surface. The one place max effort pays for itself.

standards-confidence._note: Standards 95%-confidence pass (docs/tasks/standards-95-confidence-completion-brief.md): register-row verification (M1), record-grain applicability (M2), primary-text registration of sovereign instruments. Judgment-dense, litigation-facing; Fable 5.1 per the brief. Deterministic Lens 0 (audit/readiness/diff/confidence lint) never spawns.
